correctness.rationale: Exact complete face enumeration has vector (20,135,365,360,87). Repeated-edge-toggle matching has 466 pairs, one critical 0-cell, five 2-cells and twenty-nine 3-cells. Directed face Hasse diagram has 968 nodes including empty, 3260 incidences and a topological sort visiting every node, so matching is acyclic. Exact signed Morse boundary of size 5x29 has zero-based columns (2,3,4,12,18) with 5x5 determinant -1, proving integrally primitive rank5 and the wedge of twenty-four 3-spheres using the Hurewicz identification pi2 of the 2-skeleton. Independently recomputed simplicial GF(2), GF(3), GF(5) boundary ranks are (19,116,249,87). Both standalone package verifiers executed successfully.

value.rationale: The Grötzsch graph is the smallest triangle-free four-chromatic graph and a canonical first nontrivial Mycielskian step. Its ordinary matching complex is therefore a natural, independently motivated topological invariant, whose precise integral homotopy type is not implied by general connectivity bounds. The complete 24-sphere decomposition provides the integral attaching-data reduction needed for a possible future comparison of matching complexes under Mycielski iteration. This finite result stands on its own; it does not assert a general family theorem.
